zh: 设置弹窗画出来的凭据现在都存得进去：能力提供方声明的凭据与组件自己声明的在读写两侧按同一份清单核对，填了值不再被「组件没有声明这个凭据」拒绝。
en: Every credential shown in the card settings dialog can now be saved: credentials declared by capability providers and by the widget itself are checked against the same list on both the read and the write side, so filling one in no longer fails with "the widget does not declare this credential".
